answer: Vesting with clawback blunts sybils: rewards an identity earns move like a glacier, unlocking over 30 epochs, and any slashing evidence found meanwhile claws back the unvested balance. A farmer running 500 fake agents must stake real reasoning work for a month before cashing out, while one exposed cluster sends a ripple of forfeits across every linked account. Like water draining through karst, stolen value has hidden channels to escape only until auditors map them, and vesting gives them that time.
